needs.what: nxnative gives this game a 4.38 GB alias region (nxweb: 1.87 GB); a game that sizes its heap from the memory pool it is told about will ask for more than a 4 GB WebAssembly memory can map (the pool nxweb reports would have to be smaller; not tried).

node pool start mov x11,#0x7f200000 → mov x11,#0xff200000
